title: Brazilian Cheesy Seafood Fried Rice
description: A delicious and easy seafood fried rice dish with Brazilian flavors and a creamy cheesy twist.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 3 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the yellow rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the sausage and shrimp.
Add the seafood seasoning and stir to combine.
Add the shredded cheese and stir to combine until the cheese is melted and well combined.
Transfer the rice mixture to a serving platter or individual plates.
Top with fried onion and chopped scallions if desired.
